name: Air SIAM
blurb: Thailand's new national flag carrier, flying a premium-focused network from Bangkok Suvarnabhumi to Europe and across the country.

about: Air SIAM is Thailand's national flag carrier, flying from Bangkok Suvarnabhumi with a premium-focused product.
It was founded in September 2026 as the successor to the country's previous flag carrier. Its name recalls Siam, as Thailand was known until 1939.
The airline is still in a phase of rapid expansion, building its network around premium connections through Bangkok.
network: Two parts of the network are complete. In Europe, Air SIAM serves the major hubs and many secondary airports; at home, it flies to every airport in Thailand except DMK, HHP, UTP, CJM and PHS.

Expansion is now under way across Asia, beginning with Southeast Asia, with the aim of reaching every hub in the region. Premium long-haul services to North America and flights to Australia and Oceania are in planning. Africa and South America are not part of current plans.
